title: Showoff
description: Adds Terraria-style item sharing to the ingame chat
body:
# Showoff

*Terraria-style item chatting*

This mod was originally just a random 3am thought: 
> It'd be cool if I could chat items like in Terraria

Many desk-slamming sessions later, we finally have it:
A vanilla-style way to chat items

![An image of an iron axe in the ingame chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df47d9be28e40302790a47da41dc9cbead9713a4_0.webp)

# Using this mod

It's really simple, actually. After you have this mod and it's dependencies installed, just type [i] into the ingame chat.

The item that is being held in your main hand will be inserted into the chat!

# Dependencies

* Any recent version of fabric api

# Notes

> This mod must be installed on both the client, and the server in order to achieve full functionality.

Without the mod being installed on the server, players will just see "[i]" in chat

Without the mod being installed on the client, players will see a regular message without the item preview

This mod modifies client messages containing "[i]", causing the game to flag them as "insecure"
